text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Dreams"... A dream is supposed to be all 
sparkly and bright.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's what everyone thinks, right? But ya 
know, my dream ain't like that.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"It's way more urgent than that—ain't no 
time to wait. Anyone'd want to treat their 
family to nice things, right? Even if 
we're a bit poor."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: It's cold, Tama-nee-nee...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but look. If we do this... it's nice 
and warm, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even if we're poor, we can still give each 
other warmth in our hearts. But y'know, 
that just ain't enough.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Why do I run? Saying it's "because I want 
to make my dreams come true" isn't quite 
right.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"My dream is something I HAVE to make come 
true! That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's do this!! Let's register 
for the Twinkle Series right away!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Come on, chop-chop. Hurry up and stamp 
your seal on this paper, won't ya!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what am I, a debt collector?! No, I 
ain't!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume I signed a trainer contract 
with, Tamamo Cross, demanded to enter the 
Twinkle Series before she was even fully 
prepared.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna win and win and just keep on 
winning. So that Pa, Ma, and the little 
ones can live an easy life."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Hurry up and let me unleash these 
lightning-fast legs of mine. I'm itching 
to win so bad!"
choice_data_list: It's not going to be that easy...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oho, you said it. In that case, I'll show 
ya just how strong my feelings are in the 
mock race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decided to run a light mock 
race on the training track, but...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Here I go! The final stretch! Special 
Move: 'White Lightning'!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, what the heck?! There's no open 
pathanywhere?! Grrr, all of 'em are just 
big lumps in the way...!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Move, get outta the way, move it, will 
ya~~!! Grrrraaaahhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Boxed in from all sides by Umamusume of 
different builds, Tamamo Cross sank into 
the pack.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
What a shame, Tama-chan. And you tried 
sooo hard, too~

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Shut up! That was totally a foul!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All clumping together just to get in my 
way... What are you, a bunch of aunties 
swarming a clearance sale?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This Umamusume is Super Creek. Close 
friends with Tamamo Cross, she's an 
Umamusume brimming with motherly warmth.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what should Tama-chan have done 
to run better?
choice_data_list:
I need to give myself a little more 
breathing room.

I need to give myself a little more 
breathing room, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I hear ya, I hear ya. It's that, right? Ya 
wanna say I should 'enjoy the race more', 
ain'tcha...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even though I know better, I just lose my 
cool. I gotta win, I just gotta...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross has two major hurdles to 
overcome. One is her frail constitution. 
Without building up her stamina and frame, 
she won't be able to contest races midway 
through.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And another is her 'unyielding spirit,' 
which is also a strength. Her desire to 
win can be so overwhelming that it 
sometimes narrows her vision."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If I can just run properly, I'm capable of 
way more than this. That's right, I'm the 
"White Lightning"...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I oughta be able to blaze across the turf 
even more freely! Just like a bolt of 
lightning!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The image is there. Now, as long as 
experience and ability follow, it should 
be achievable. To do that...
choice_data_list: Here, Tamamo Cross. Take this paper.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hm, well, that's...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't that the Twinkle Series 
registration form I gave ya?!
choice_data_list:
I've stamped it, so now let's hone it in 
actual races

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what are you doing... After all was 
said and done, you really did understand 
how I felt, huh...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah...! Hell yeahhhhh! I'm gonna do 
this! Nothin's gonna change just sittin' 
around waitin'!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Sure, nobody knows my hidden power yet. 
But from here on out, I'll make it echo 
across the whole country!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, I'm sure you can do it, 
Tama-chan. I'll be cheering for you, too—.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And so, how about we make some red bean 
rice today? There, there, good girl...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, don't go treating me like a kid! I 
might be small, but I'm a full-fledged...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hey, stop patting my head! Creek, 
one of these days I'm gonna make you gasp 
for breath on the track... 
Whoa-whoa-whoaaa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Passionate roars and screams echoed under 
the blue sky. And thus—the tiny white 
lightning bolt was unleashed into the 
Twinkle Series.
